data.name: Amrish
data.gender_notes: Amrish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amṛta’, meaning ‘immortal’ or ‘everlasting’. In Hindu mythology, Amrish is the name of a god, a river, or a rare gemstone. The name Amrish carries the meaning “Immortal, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amrish usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes eternal life and divine grace.
data.etymology: Amrish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amrish total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Amrish holds cultural significance as it is associated with the God Amrish, who represents prosperity, happiness, and good fortune in Hindu mythology. This name is reminiscent of the magical power of life, hope, and perseverance.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Amrish lies in its root word, Amrta, which symbolizes immortality, eternal happiness, and the divine nectar of life.
